title: Joomla Extension - acymailing.com - Site modules rendered outside their access level in AcyMailing 1.0.0 - 11.1.1 - An…
description: A vulnerability in the Joomla extension AcyMailing versions 1.0.0 through 11.1.1 allows unauthenticated visitors to view site modules outside their intended Joomla access levels. This results in unauthorized disclosure of content reserved for higher access levels. The WordPress plugin is not affected.
